name: Mühlbauer Holding AG
summary: Mühlbauer Holding AG provides equipment solutions for manufacturing, personalization, and shipping in Germany, the rest of Europe, Asia, the Americas, Africa, and internationally. The company offers systems and technologies for ID cards, driver's licenses and vehicle registration cards, banking cards, gift and loyalty cards, health cards, and GSM cards; and high-precision equipment, such as die and wire bonding, encapsulation, tape inspection, molding, electrical test and pre-personalization, and flip chip IC module production.
